messages:
Nina: Heads up - in chaos test we forced hosted pool OOM and saw fallback to dedicated; KV snapshot handshake failed with KMS unwrap error, causing fallback to stall for ~6s per request. Producing spike.
Raj: Ouch. Which KMS error? Time skew or key missing?
Nina: KMS returned InvalidCiphertext. Debug shows adapter passing snapshot token with an old envelope key id (was rotated).
Oliver: We need graceful degrade: if KMS unwrap fails, we should log and proceed with cold start rather than stall retries. Right now adapter retries for 5s.
Tara: Also we should include envelope key id in the handshake so runtime can request alternate key or we can detect rotation mismatch earlier.
SecurityBot: Note: rotation and key access auditing required. Any fallback that bypasses unwrap must still record an event.
InfraBot: Canary rollback: hosted-fallbacks v3 -> 0 hosts (rollback triggered).
Raj: Proposal: change flow to non-blocking: adapter requests unwrap async with 500ms deadline, if unwrap not confirmed fall back to cold start and emit fallback_unwrap_timeout metric. Add retry only for transient errors, not InvalidCiphertext.
Nina: Add a preflight check: before sending snapshot token, query KMS for key id availability for that runtime region. If key missing, skip snapshot and avoid unnecessary unwraps.
Oliver: Also add versioned envelope metadata to the token so runtime can do a no-op unwrap check cheaply.
Tara: Security: we must avoid creating a new leakage vector. Ensure an unwrap failure does not reveal whether a snapshot existed for a tenant. Mask errors in surface metrics but include full error in audit logs accessible only to Sec/Ops.
Raj: I'll update INF-812 to include unwrap timeout and preflight KMS check.
Nina: I'll add a chaos test case for KMS rotation and key unavailability.
InfraBot: Created card INF-820: "fallback-kv-kms-failure-handling".
Oliver: OK - quick roll plan: add timeout+preflight, test in canary, then re-enable. Keep telemetry to correlate cache restores vs unwrap errors.
Tara: I'll update RFC addendum to call out unwrap failure modes and policy for observable metrics.
Nina: Thanks. I'll follow up with logs and heap of traces from the chaos run.
Oliver: TY. We'll re-run canary after fixes.
Nina: Meeting in 30 to triage?
Raj: On it.
InfraBot: Meeting scheduled: fallback-kv-kms-triage 10:30.
